The 'View Real-Time Operational Dashboard' (llg_001) documents the Hospital Manager's access to real-time metrics, which directly supports the HLG's emphasis on real-time monitoring. The 'Export Operational Reports' (llg_002) describes the capability for exporting historical data, fulfilling the HLG's requirement for analyzing and ensuring compliance with operational performance.
